label.purpose: Eyebrows, specs, numbers — short strings only (JetBrains Mono).

shadows.name: brand-glow
shadows.purpose: Brand signal on focused/active interactive surfaces.

motion.name: grid-fade
motion.purpose: Background-grid cell fade-back after hover; instant fill on hover.

components.name: Logo
components.description: Official LabGenie mark (open dial arc + five brand-blue spectrum dots) with the Manrope wordmark.
components.html: labgenie.ai
components.css: .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #EDF1F6; } .ds-logo-word { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-logo-tld { color: #0066FF; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA — white text on the brand-blue gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1A78FF, #0066FF); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px -10px rgba(0,102,255,0.75); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px -8px rgba(0,102,255,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary CTA — transparent on a strong hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); color: #EDF1F6; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0066FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Mono uppercase tag with a pulsing brand-blue dot.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: #A6B2C2; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-eyebrow-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #0066FF; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Floating surface used for signature panels (COA reconciliation, modules).
components.css: .ds-panel { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.025), rgba(255,255,255,0)), #18212E; color: #EDF1F6; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset, 0 24px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }

narrative.overview: LabGenie is a dark, engineered surface that reads like precision instrumentation glowing in a low-lit control room. The palette is deliberately disciplined: one Datadivr brand blue, one supporting azure, an ink ground, and white. Warmth is rationed to a single amber that means exactly one thing — out of spec. The system is Datadivr-aligned: LabGenie is Datadivr's flagship product and carries its exact mark and brand blue (#0066FF). It rejects generic dark SaaS, legacy enterprise ERP, consumer food branding, and overhyped AI-startup voice.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-grounded dark surface (#0E141C) with cool blue-tinted neutrals stepped above it.
One electric-blue brand signal; everything else is structural neutral.
Hairline borders and grid structure over heavy cards or shadows.
Motion that demonstrates the product working, gated by reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Datadivr Blue is the only saturated hue on any screen. Azure is a tint of the same blue, not a second color.

rules.name: The Amber-Means-Failure Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where a value is out of spec. Never as decoration. If nothing has failed, there is no amber on the screen.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for labels, specs, and numbers — never for body sentences.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Define structure with 1px borders at rgba(255,255,255,0.08) before reaching for a shadow.

dos: Do use Datadivr Blue (#0066FF) as the single saturated signal — CTAs, logo dots, resolved states, focus rings, grid hover.
Do ground every surface on Ink (#0E141C) and step neutrals upward with cool blue-tinted tiers.
Do keep body text at #EDF1F6 / #A6B2C2 for AAA contrast on ink; reserve #97A4B6 for tertiary metadata only.
Do use Accent Text (#6BAAFF) for any small blue text — labels, links, inline emphasis, chips; #0066FF small text fails AAA.
Do render the logo from the exact official artwork (white arc + five #0066FF dots, labgenie.ai in Manrope).
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and keep content visible by default.
Do carry status meaning with an icon plus color, never color alone.
donts: Don't build generic dark SaaS: no purple-gradient hero, no hero-metric template, no identical icon-card grids.
Don't drift toward legacy enterprise ERP: no cluttered gray industrial chrome.
Don't use consumer food-brand warmth: amber is failure-only, not a warm accent.
Don't adopt overhyped AI-startup voice or visuals: show the mechanism, never claim magic.
Don't introduce a second saturated color. Azure is a tint of the brand blue.
Don't use border-left/right > 1px as a colored stripe, gradient-clipped text as a new choice, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't set body copy in JetBrains Mono — mono is for labels, specs, and numbers only.
